## 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. "I am frustrated when I try to transfer datasets of type X because..."

Describe the feature, command-line option, or modification you would like to see added. Share examples of how researchers would execute it:
```bash
rds-cli my-new-command --bucket researchers-data
```

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, performance requirements, API examples, or links to relevant Ceph/S3/GCS documentation here.
